items.title: mysql fdw SQL injection through a multi-byte character set escaping bypass
items.summary: mysql fdw builds string literals for queries sent to the remote MySQL server with an escaping routine that is not character-set aware. When the connection uses a multi-byte character set such as GBK, SJIS or Big5 and MySQL's default backslash escaping is in effect, a crafted value whose trailing byte is 0x5C absorbs the escaping backslash and leaves the following quote unescaped. The routine handles every…

items.title: mongo fdw connection URI injection through unencoded option values
items.summary: mongo fdw builds the mongodb:// connection URI by inserting option values without percent-encoding them, so URI metacharacters (@ : / ? & =) in a value are parsed as part of the URI structure. A role that is not a superuser but has USAGE on a foreign server can set the username and password options in its own user mapping. An @ or other metacharacter in those values can point the connection at a host the attacker…

items.title: hdfs fdw HiveQL injection through pushed-down IN and = ANY(array) string literals
items.summary: hdfs fdw builds string literals for IN and = ANY(array) clauses pushed down to the remote Hive or Spark server without escaping single quotes. An authenticated user with only SELECT on a foreign table can supply a crafted array value that breaks out of the literal and changes the HiveQL query, which then runs on the remote server with the foreign server's credentials. items.summary: mongo fdw converts id values to 12-byte MongoDB ObjectIds with libbson functions that read a fixed number of bytes without checking the input length: 12 bytes for a bytea id, and 24 characters for name-typed values and $oid fields in JSON. items.title: Gimp: heap-based buffer overflow in the jif loader
items.summary: A flaw was found in the file-gif-load plugin in GIMP. When processing a specially crafted JIF image file, a 32-bit integer overflow occurs during the pixel buffer size calculation, while the zlib output limit is computed separately without wrapping. This leads to an undersized heap allocation, resulting in a heap-based buffer overflow when the compressed image data is decompressed. This issue can result in an…

items.title: Mass assignment guard bypass in the Laravel MongoDB Eloquent integration
items.summary: A vulnerability in the MongoDB integration package for the Laravel framework allows an unauthorized user to bypass mass assignment attribute protections. When an application uses attribute deny-lists to guard sensitive model fields, specially crafted request payloads containing database operator keys can circumvent these protections. An unauthorized user with network access to an affected application endpoint can…

items.title: Memory leak on duplicate fields in key vault documents in libmongocrypt
items.summary: An improper handling of repeated fields in encryption key documents in the MongoDB encryption support library may allow memory to be retained without release. A party able to write to the key storage collection, or a database endpoint returning such a document, may cause the memory use of the calling application process to grow for each document parsed, which may reduce performance of that process.

items.title: github.com/insomniacslk/dhcp permits denial of service through a malformed IPv4 payload length
items.summary: In github.com/insomniacslk/dhcp/dhcpv4/nclient4, BroadcastRawUDPConn.ReadFrom does not validate that the IPv4 payload length is sufficient to hold a UDP header before calculating the DHCP payload length. A frame with an IPv4 total-length field specifying fewer than eight payload bytes results in a negative DHCP length, causing a panic in buf.Consume due to a negative slice bound.

Under specific conditions, the attacker can use install.php to attempt to reinstall Drupal on the site.

The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

items.title: Optimizely Web Experimentation External Control of Critical State Data Vulnerability
